title: The Voice Behind Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When two small paths go left and right
And I don't know which one,
I stop, and hold the quiet close
Until the guessing's done.

[Chorus]
And soft behind me comes a voice
As warm as lantern light:
This is the way, walk in it, child,
This is the way tonight.

[Verse 2]
I do not have to race ahead
Or hurry, or pretend;
In quietness my strength comes back
And trusting is my friend.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So I will listen with my heart
Where all the hurry ends;
Heavenly Father whispers low,
The way He speaks to friends.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
No choosing left for me to do,
The lamp is burning low;
And still that gentle voice is near
To tell me where to go.

[Chorus]
mood: Walking music, but slow — one soft step to a beat, the pace of a child who has stopped hurrying and is letting someone else pick the turn. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeps that step all the way through, and the second half of every line comes back a beat late and a shade quieter, the way a voice sounds when it is just behind you. It starts unsettled and resolves a little further down with each verse, so the last line arrives plainly home rather than arriving anywhere new.
